SARANSH - 2026
READ. REFLECT. DISTIL. PRESENT.
AN EXPERIENTIAL BOOK REVIEW COMPETITION
INTER - UNIVERSITY
BOOK REVIEW COMPETITION
OCTOBER 06, 2026 | 09:00 AM - 03:00 PM
VENUE: ALLIANCE UNIVERSITY, CENTRAL CAMPUS
SARANSH meaning “essence” or “summary” challenges students
to go beyond simply reading a book. It is an opportunity to
decode ideas, question perspectives, connect concepts to the real
world, and communicate insights with impact.
Step into the world of leadership, strategy, management,
innovation, organisational culture and professional development
and bring the essence of a great book to life in just 8 minutes.
Books for Review
▪ ‘Seven habits of highly effective people’ by Stephen Covey
▪ ‘Outliers’ by Malcom Gladwell
▪ ‘Turn the Ship Around! by L. David Marquet
▪ ‘Red Ocean Strategy’ by Saurav Kumar
▪ ‘Creativity, Inc.’ by Ed Catmull
Organized by Management Development Program and Corporate Training Department
₹ 10,000
1 Prize st
2 Prize nd
₹ 8,000 ₹ 5,000
3 Prize rd
--- Page Break ---
THE 8-MINUTE CHALLENGE
WHAT MAKES SARANSH DIFFERENT?
WHAT YOUR REVIEW SHOULD COVER
▪ About the author - introduce the author and the
context behind the book.
▪ The essence of the book - distil the most important
ideas, arguments and insights.
▪ Critical perspective - go beyond summary. examine
ideas, perspectives, strengths and limitations.
▪ Real-world connections - connect the book's insights
with corporate situations, leadership, management
and everyday life.
▪ Your take - share your team's interpretation,
reflections and key learnings.
▪ Minimum: 6 minutes
▪ Maximum: 8 minutes
▪ Presentations shorter than 6 minutes or longer than
8 minutes will be disqualified.
RULES AND REGULATIONS – SARANSH 2026
▪ Team Composition: Each team shall comprise four students.
▪ Book Selection: Each team may choose one book from the prescribed list of five books for the review.
▪ Dress Code: Participants must attend the event in formal attire. However, participants should not wear a blazer or
any other clothing that displays the name of their college.
▪ Presentation Time: Presentations shorter than 6 minutes or longer than 8 minutes will be disqualified.
▪ Question & Answer: There will be no question-and-answer session following the presentation.
▪ Evaluation: The presentations will be evaluated by industry professionals and members of academia.
It is not about how much of the book you can repeat.
It is about how much meaning you can extract and how effectively you can communicate it.
RECOGNITION & PRIZES
▪ THE BEST SPEAKER AWARD (One outstanding speaker from each participating team)
▪ OVERALL BEST SPEAKER AWARD (For the speaker who makes the strongest individual impact)
▪ THE BEST TEAM AWARD
SARANSH 2026
Don't just review the book. Reveal its essence.
Read it. Understand it. Challenge it. Present it.
Are you ready to distil an entire book into 8 minutes?
